title: Twig repository configuration
description: Schema for the .twig.toml file at the root of a Twig repository.

ignore_for_view.description: Files or folders to ignore in the file browser view. A trailing slash matches a folder; a bare name matches any path component.

tabs.description: Tabs to display. If empty or not present, all tabs are shown.

deleteable.description: Whether the repository can be deleted from the UI.

private.description: Whether the repository is private (read operations require authentication).

present.description: Presentation configuration. Any additional string key becomes a template variable.

files.description: Markdown files to include in the presentation view.

paper.description: Paper (long-form reading) configuration. When present, a Paper tab renders the Markdown pages under dir as one continuous, lazily loaded document.

dir.description: Directory whose Markdown pages form the Paper view, read in sorted order.

scripts.description: Scripts configuration. Each key names a script group; nesting groups builds the hierarchy shown as sub-tabs in the Scripts tab. The tab only appears when a group lists at least one script.

scriptGroup.description: A script group: its display name, its scripts, and groups nested inside it.

name.description: Display name of the group; defaults to the group's key.

scripts.description: The scripts in this group, in configured order.

name.description: Display name; defaults to the file's base name.

path.description: Repository-relative path, served raw so curl can fetch it.

shell.description: Interpreter the download-and-run command pipes into.
